note: A set of drawn particles that share the art, the sound, and the place on a unit they hang from.

fields.name: package
fields.note: Which set of art and sound the client draws them with.

fields.name: particle
fields.note: Which particle, by the number its name gives, as spec/messages.md works it out.

fields.name: flags
fields.note: How each particle of the group behaves, one bit each, as a 4.17 client reads them: 1 kept alive, not ending by itself; 2 unread; 4 scaled to the bound unit's bounding box and its effect scale (to 1 where the bound object cannot be attacked); 8 placed at the positions given rather than hung on bone and targetBone, made even where a nonzero boundTo is unknown (otherwise held and tried again) and with an unknown target not remembered; 16 not turned to follow its direction; 32 simulated while off screen; 64 laid flat on the ground's slope, facing as forward (+Z where facing is zero); 128 facing its target; 256 driven by the bound unit's resource bar. Bits 9 to 15 are unread.

fields.name: targetBone
fields.note: Where on the unit aimed at they hang, by the number the name of that place gives, as spec/messages.md works it out.

fields.name: bone
fields.note: Where on the unit that made them they hang, by the same reading.
